product.name: GMCC Universe (In House Underwrite)
notes: 本文件仅由 PDF 原文结构化而来，未加入任何 PDF 之外的常识或行业惯例。
PDF 内部互相冲突的规则一律不在此处静默解决，改为 status=conflicted / manualConfirmationRequired=true，并在 universe-v14-conflicts.json 中列出。
sourcePage 指 PDF 的页码（与幻灯片页脚编号一致，1-44）。

conditionDsl.description: conditions 为 AND 关系的条件数组。每个条件形如 {field, op, value}。op 支持: eq, ne, in, notIn, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, missing, isTrue, isFalse, anyOf(嵌套条件数组，OR)。conditions 为空数组表示该规则始终适用（信息型/文档型规则）。
conditionDsl.unknownHandling: 任一 field 在 case 中缺失时，规则不得判定为通过或失败，必须输出 insufficient_data 并把该 field 写入缺失清单。

rules.title: 仅限 6 个州的指定 county 放款
rules.description: Universe 仅在 California、Nevada、Washington、Texas、Georgia、Massachusetts 6 个州的指定 county 内放款。
rules.sourceText: Lending is available in select counties in California, Nevada, Washington, Texas, Georgia, Massachusetts-6 States. (p2) / Lending states with county limits-CA-11 counties, TX-4, NV-1, GA-15, WA-3, MA-3 (p6)

rules.title: 合格 county 清单
rules.description: 合格 county：CA(北加：San Francisco, Alameda, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Sacramento, Contra Costa；南加：Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego)；TX(Collin, Dallas, Fort Bend, Harris)；GA(Barrow, Bartow, Cherokee, Clayton, Cobb, DeKalb, Douglas, Fayette, Forsyth, Fulton, Gwinnett, Henry, Paulding, Rockdale, Spalding)；MA(Middlesex, Norfolk, Suffolk)；NV(Clark)；WA(King, Pierce, Snohomish)。
rules.sourceText: Lending areas — Northern California / Southern California / Texas / Georgia / Massachusetts / Nevada / Washington county lists (p7)

rules.title: Texas 不做 primary 的 Cash-Out 与 Rate/Term
rules.description: TX：primary 的 C/O 与 R/T 不可做；2nd home 与 Investment 可以。
rules.sourceText: Notes: 1: No TX primary C/O and R/T, 2nd home and Investment OK (p7)

rules.title: TX SB 17：不向来自中国的 Foreign National 与 NPRA 放款
rules.description: Per TX SB 17，TX 州不向来自中国的 Foreign national 和 NPRA（非永久居民）放款。
rules.sourceText: Per TX SB 17: Universe will not lend to Foreign national and NPRA from China in TX. (p7, p30)

rules.title: 6 个合格州内的 county 例外
rules.description: Investor 对 6 个合格州内的 county 开放例外申请（需走例外流程）。
rules.sourceText: Investor is opening for county exception within 6 eligible states (p3)

rules.title: 开档时须按 county 限制录入准确地址
rules.description: MLO 在 EC 开档时须录入准确的 subject property address 并适用 county 限制。
rules.sourceText: Open file in EC(Recommended) with accurate subject property address, apply county restrictions (p3) / Make sure subject property is located in the lending areas. (p11)

rules.title: 可做交易类型
rules.description: 支持 Purchase、Rate/Term refinance、Cash-Out refinance；亦支持 Delayed Financing。
rules.sourceText: Transaction type – Purchase, refi or cashout (p3) / Max LTV/CLTV/HLTV-- 60% for Purchase, R/T & C/O (p14)

rules.title: Cash-out 无 seasoning / title seasoning 要求
rules.description: Cash out 无 seasoning 要求，无 title seasoning 要求。
rules.sourceText: No cash out seasoning requirement. (p2) / Cash out – no title seasoning requirement (p32)

rules.title: Delayed Financing 定义：60 天内
rules.description: Delayed financing 指自 closing 日到 application 日在 60 天以内。
rules.sourceText: Delayed financing – within 60 days ( from date of closing to application date) (p32)

rules.title: Delayed Financing 需要 source of fund
rules.description: Delayed Financing 需要对原购房款进行 sourcing；Regular Cash out 不需要 sourcing。
rules.sourceText: Source of fund-Delayed Financing – need to source the payment for the purchase / Cash out – no sourcing required (p32)

rules.title: Texas 50a6 与 Texas delayed financing 不可做
rules.description: Texas 50a6 不合格；Texas delayed financing 不合格；Texas 的 2nd home 与 investment cash out 可以（title 须按 investment 处理）。
rules.sourceText: Texas 50a6 – not eligible; Texas delayed financing – not eligible / Texas cash out on 2nd and investment – ok (title must be ok as investment) (p32)

rules.title: Cash-out 用途 LOE（Business Purpose / DSCR）
rules.description: Business Purpose loan（DSCR）上需要 Cash-out purpose LOE。
rules.sourceText: Cash-out purpose LOE is required on a Business Purpose loan (DSCR). See examples on LOE. (p12)

rules.title: POA 允许，但 cash out 除外
rules.description: 允许 POA，cash out 交易除外；若使用 POA，borrower 须 wet sign 初始 1003。
rules.sourceText: POA is allowed (except for cash out). (p30) / If POA is needed, borrower needs to wet sign initial 1003. (p10)

rules.title: Cash out proceeds 不可作为 reserves
rules.description: Cash out proceeds 不能作为 reserves（投资房 DSCR 且 LTV<=45% 的情形见 DSCR/Reserve 规则，PDF 内部说法不一致）。
rules.sourceText: Cash out proceed can't be used as reserves. (p2) / C/O proceed can't be as reserves except investment DSCR for LTV<=45% (p6)

rules.title: 可做 occupancy 类型
rules.description: Primary、2nd home、Investment 均可做。
rules.sourceText: For Primary, 2nd home and Investment transaction (p14)

rules.title: 不得为了价格而把 occupancy 写成 primary
rules.description: 2nd home 与 primary 的 rate 和 LTV 相同；primary 与 investment 的 rate 相同。因此不应把 occupancy 硬写成 primary。
rules.sourceText: Occupancy – the rate and LTV is the same between 2nd home and primary. The rate is the same between primary and investment. So don't try to squeeze the occupancy as primary. (p10)

rules.title: Investment 走 DSCR，Primary/2nd 走 DTA
rules.description: Primary 与 2nd home 用 DTA；Investment 用 DSCR（DSCR 可以 no ratio）。
rules.sourceText: DTA for primary & 2nd home; DSCR for investment (DSCR can be no ratio) (p2)

rules.title: 最高贷款额 $3M（In House）
rules.description: Effective 03-02-2026：Max loan amount = $3M - In House。
rules.sourceText: Effective on 03-02-2026: Max loan amount = $3M-In House (p14) / In house to $3M, Higher loan amount by exception. (p2)

rules.title: 超过 $3M 需 exception
rules.description: 更高的贷款额需走 exception（PDF 第 3 页把 exception 流程写为 >$2M，与 $3M in-house 上限并存）。
rules.sourceText: Higher loan amount by exception. Successful case study on slides 4. (p2) / Loan amount>$2M exception process (p3)

rules.title: >$2M exception 所需信息
rules.description: Exception 需提供：Property Address；Property value/Loan amount；Transaction type；Occupancy；配偶职业、工作年限与资产/存款（如适用）；主申请人工作年限与资产/存款（reserves）；Foreign National 或 U.S. Citizen/Permanent Resident 身份。
rules.sourceText: (1): Information needed: Property Address / Property value/Loan amount / Transaction type / Occupancy / Spouse's occupation, length of employment, and assets/savings (if applicable) / Primary Applicant's, length of employment, and assets/savings (reserves) / Foreign National or U.S. Citizen/Permanent Resident (p3)

rules.title: 无 financed property 数量限制
rules.description: 无 financed property 数量上限。
rules.sourceText: No# of finance property limit. (p2) / No # of financed property limits (p6)

rules.title: 最高 LTV/CLTV/HLTV 60%（所有 occupancy 与交易类型）
rules.description: Effective 03-02-2026：Max LTV/CLTV/HLTV 60% for Primary & 2nd Home & INVESTMENT；60% for Purchase, R/T & C/O。
rules.sourceText: Max LTV/CLTV/HLTV – 60% for Primary & 2nd Home & INVESTMENT / Max LTV/CLTV/HLTV-- 60% for Purchase, R/T & C/O (p14) / Max to LTV 60% for all transaction & Occupancy type. -On slide 14 (p2)

rules.title: （冲突版本）Investment / Cash-Out 最高 LTV 50%
rules.description: 第 6 页 Marketing 摘要页给出：Primary/2nd 60%，investment / C/O 50%。与第 14 页 60% 冲突。
rules.sourceText: 4: LTV: Primary/2nd -60%, investment /C/O: 50% (p6)

rules.title: （冲突版本）Delayed Financing 60% primary / Cash out 50%
rules.description: 第 32 页给出：Delayed Financing max 60% for primary，Cash out max at 50%。与第 14 页 60% 冲突。
rules.sourceText: LTV - Delayed Financing – max 60% for primary, Cash out – max at 50% (p32)

rules.title: （冲突版本）Investment Loans 最高 LTV 分档至 50%
rules.description: 第 25 页 Investment Loans 表格的 Maximum LTVs 分档为 45.01-50% 与 Up to 45%，即最高 50%。与第 14/22 页的 60% 冲突。
rules.sourceText: Maximum LTVs: 45.01- 50% / Up to 45% (Investment Loans table, p25)

rules.title: LTV 计算所用价值基准（purchase 取较低者）
rules.description: 第 12 页：DTA ratio 基于 purchase price 或 appraisal value 中较低者。是否同样适用于 LTV 需人工确认（第 21 页 DTA 表格写的是 appraisal 市值）。
rules.sourceText: 14. DTA ratio is based on purchase price or appraisal value – whichever is LOWER (p12)

rules.title: CLTV/HLTV 与 LTV 同限
rules.description: LTV、CLTV、HLTV 适用同一上限。存在次级留置权时须一并计算。
rules.sourceText: Max LTV/CLTV/HLTV – 60% (p14)

rules.title: 可选产品期限
rules.description: 提供 30 年固定、15 年固定、10/1 ARM、7/1 ARM、5/1 ARM。
rules.sourceText: Programs offer 30 years fixed, 15 years fixed, 10/1 ARM, 7/1 ARM and 5/1 ARM (p15)

rules.title: 固定利率按锁定 Note rate 计算资格
rules.description: Fixed rate loans are qualified at locked Note rate。
rules.sourceText: Fixed rate loans are qualified at locked Note rate (p15)

rules.title: ARM 按 Note rate 与 fully indexed rate 较高者计算资格
rules.description: ARM（5/1、7/1、10/1）按锁定 Note rate 与 fully indexed rate（index + margin）较高者计算。Index = 1 year UST CM weekly (1 yr CMT)，Margin = 3.25%，Cap = 2/2/6。
rules.sourceText: ARM loans must be qualified at the higher of the locked Note rate or the fully indexed rate (5/1, 7/1, 10/1). Fully indexed rate = index + margin. Index = 1 year UST CM weekly (1 yr CMT)- 3.79% as of 06-14-2026. Margin = 3.25%. Cap = 2/2/6 (p15)

rules.title: Index 取值存在两个不同数值
rules.description: 第 15 页 index 3.79%（as of 06-14-2026）；第 44 页 Rate Index Base Value 3.59% [Weekly CMT]。计算 fully indexed rate 前必须人工确认当期 index。
rules.sourceText: Index = 1 year UST CM weekly (1 yr CMT)- 3.79% as of 06-14-2026 (p15) / Rate Index Base Value 3.59% [Weekly CMT] (p44)

rules.title: 不提供 Interest Only
rules.description: No Interest ONLY options。
rules.sourceText: No Interest ONLY options (p15)

rules.title: Lock 规则
rules.description: 只有 30 天 lock；lock cut off 为 2pm；UW approval 之前不可 lock；lock 后文件必须 close 以维持 100% pull thru。
rules.sourceText: 30 days lock only. Lock cut off is at 2pm / No lock until underwriting approval / Once it is lock, file must close to maintain 100% pull thru ratio (p16)

rules.title: Lock 后变更触发 relock（worst case pricing）
rules.description: 锁定后以下变更会 relock 并采用 worst case pricing：更换 loan program（如 5/1 ARM 换 10/1 ARM）、rate 变更、贷款额提高（降低贷款额不算 relock）。
rules.sourceText: Any changes after lock will subject to relock with worst case pricing and will impact PULL THRU negatively: a change in loan program (i.e., 5/1 ARM to 10/1 ARM), a change in rate, an increase of loan amount (reducing loan amount is NOT relock) (p16)

rules.title: Point charge 不可高于初始 LE
rules.description: Investor 不常调整 rate，因此不能在初始 LE 之后提高 point charge；无有效 change of circumstance。
rules.sourceText: 7. Point charge, please note that investor does not change rate often, so we cannot increase the point charge from initial LE. There is no valid change of circumstances for point to be increased. (p9)

rules.title: 无最低 FICO 要求
rules.description: No min FICO requirement。
rules.sourceText: No min FICO requirement (p18)

rules.title: FICO 低于 680 需管理层批准
rules.description: FICO 低于 680 需 management approval，且必须有 compensating factors —— 更低的 LTV + 更多 reserve。
rules.sourceText: 4. FICO below 680 – need management approval – must have compensating factors – lower LTV + more reserve. (p8) / FICO lower then 680 need Management approval (p18)

rules.title: 无最低 tradeline 要求
rules.description: No min tradeline requirement。
rules.sourceText: No min tradeline requirement (p18)

rules.title: 房贷迟缴容忍度 1x30x12
rules.description: 过去 12 个月允许 1 次 mortgage late（1x30x12）。
rules.sourceText: Allow 1 mortgage late in last 12 months (1x30x12) (p18)

rules.title: Installment/Revolving 迟缴容忍度
rules.description: Installment 与 revolving：3x30x12、2x60x12、1x90x12；超过 90 天迟缴 —— 不合格。
rules.sourceText: Installment and revolving account – 3x30x12, 2x60x12, 1x90x12 / over 90 days late – ineligible (p18)

rules.title: 重大信用事件 seasoning 1 年
rules.description: Major credit events（foreclosures / bankruptcy）需满 1 年。
rules.sourceText: Major credit events (foreclosures/bankruptcy) – 1 years (p18)

rules.title: Foreign National 的信用报告要求
rules.description: 有 ITIN 或 SSN 的 Foreign national 需要 CR；没有 ITIN/SSN 的 Foreign national 仍需拉 CR（special credit report）以确认无信用记录。
rules.sourceText: Foreign national with ITIN or SSN – will need CR / Foreign national without ITIN or SSN – still need CR to make sure no credit (p18)

rules.title: 关闭后 12 个月内迟缴会触发 buyback
rules.description: 关闭后 12 个月内任何 late payment 或 non-payment 会导致 GMCC buyback 且 MLO 失去佣金 —— 须提醒 borrower 按时还款。
rules.sourceText: Please make sure your borrower will make on time mortgage payment. Any late payment or non-payment within 12 months of closing will cause GMCC to buyback the loan and you will loss your commission too. (p18)

rules.title: 合格借款人身份
rules.description: 必须是自然人：U.S. Citizens、Permanent resident、Non-permanent resident aliens、Foreign nationals 均可。
rules.sourceText: Must be Natural Persons - U.S Citizens, Permanent, Non-permanent resident aliens and foreign nationals are allowed. (p30)

rules.title: 在美借款人须持有效签证或本国护照
rules.description: 在美国的借款人必须持有有效 VISA（F1、B1/B2、J1、EAD 均可）或原籍国护照；接受任何类型签证且无额外价格调整。
rules.sourceText: Borrower in US must have valid VISA (F1, B1/B2, J1, EAD – all ok) or original country passport. (p30) / Accept any kind of VISA – B1/B2, F1, J1 etc…. With no additional price hit. Foreign National ok. (p2)

rules.title: Exhibit A 国别限制的适用范围
rules.description: 若借款人是 US citizen 或 green card holder，不适用 Exhibit A 国家清单；若借款人是 VISA/EAD holder 或 foreign national，则适用该清单。
rules.sourceText: If borrower is US citizen or green card holder, borrower is not subject to this list. If borrower is VISA/EAD holder or foreign national, then this list applies. (p35)

rules.title: Exhibit A：OFAC 与高风险国家清单（借款人不合格）
rules.description: VISA/EAD holder 或 foreign national 来自 Exhibit A 清单国家 —— 不合格。清单共 86 国。
rules.sourceText: Borrower from OFAC/High-risk countries (Exhibit A) — ineligible (p34) / OFAC and High-Risk Countries list 1-86 (p35)

rules.title: Exhibit A 举例：F1(越南) 不合格 / 印度出生的绿卡持有人合格
rules.description: 举例：F1 visa from Vietnam 不合格；Foreign national from Mexico 不合格 —— 可申请例外；Green card holder born in India —— 合格。
rules.sourceText: For example, F1 visa from Vietnam will NOT be eligible. Foreign national from Mexico will NOT be eligible-by exception. Green card holder that was born in India – OK - Eligible. (p35) / H1b Visa from India is not ok (India is on Exhibit A) (p39)

rules.title: 墨西哥借款人的例外说法不一致
rules.description: 第 35 页写 Mexico 的 FN 不合格「by exception」，第 2 页写「Borrower from Mexico may ok by investor exception」。是否可做必须人工确认。
rules.sourceText: Borrower from Mexico may ok by investor exception. (p2) / Foreign national from Mexico will NOT be eligible-by exception. (p35)

rules.title: 不合法居留者不合格
rules.description: Borrower that is not legally stay in the USA —— 不合格。
rules.sourceText: Borrower that is not legally stay in the USA. (p34)

rules.title: 产权持有方式：个人或 Trust
rules.description: 必须以个人或 Trust 持有，不接受 business vesting（投资房）。
rules.sourceText: Must vested in individual or Trust, no business vesting (for investment) (p30)

rules.title: 允许 Co-signer
rules.description: Co-signer ok。
rules.sourceText: Co-signer ok (p30)

rules.title: 在美借款人 1003 须用美国地址
rules.description: Borrower in US must use USA address on 1003。
rules.sourceText: Borrower in US must use USA address on 1003. (p30)

rules.title: Foreign National 在美国境外签字会延迟关闭
rules.description: Foreign National 在美国境外签署可能延迟 closing，需要在当地美国大使馆预约签署。
rules.sourceText: Foreign National signing outside of USA may delay closing – need to make signing appointment with local US Embassy. (p30)

rules.title: SSN/ITIN 必须在初始 1003 上填写正确
rules.description: 部分 foreign national 确实有 SSN 和/或 ITIN，开档前须与借款人确认，否则最终会造成合规问题。
rules.sourceText: 6. SSN/ITIN – please make sure the number on initial 1003 is correct. For some foreign nationals, they do have SSN and/or ITIN, please confirm with borrower before setting up the file. It may cause compliance issues in the end. (p9)

rules.title: 无需收入文件，1003 上不写收入
rules.description: No income doc is required；Do not put income on 1003；无需 tax transcript。
rules.sourceText: No income doc is required / Do not put income on 1003 (p23) / No income needed on 1003 (employment info only), no income doc required, no tax transcript needed. (p2)

rules.title: 1003 需 2 年雇佣信息
rules.description: 1003 上需要 2 年的 employment info —— 雇主名称（或自雇的公司名）、职务（自雇则为业务类型）。
rules.sourceText: Need 2 years employment info on 1003 - name of employer (or self employment business name), occupation (position or type of business for SE). (p23)

rules.title: Employment 可以是 student / retiree / homemaker
rules.description: Employment can be student, retiree, homemaker。
rules.sourceText: Employment can be student, retiree, homemaker (p23)

rules.title: 必须填写真实雇佣信息（会跑 fraud report）
rules.description: 1003 上必须填写真实的美国雇佣信息。曾有 borrower 写成 homemaker/retiree 却使用 business assets 资格。GMCC 与 investor 都会跑 fraud report。
rules.sourceText: 10. Employment – please put true employment on 1003 (for US employment). We have files with borrowers as homemakers or retirees and use business assets to qualify. We need to run fraud reports (investor will run its own fraud report). (p10)

rules.title: UW 不把雇佣类型与资产水平挂钩
rules.description: UW 不会把雇佣类型与资产水平做关联（例：waiter 也可以有 $10m 存款）。
rules.sourceText: 5. Put true employment on 1003. UW do not link types of employment to level of assets (e.g waiter can have $10m in the bank.) (p11)

rules.title: Exhibit B 禁止行业：业主与员工均不合格
rules.description: Exhibit B（Prohibited Businesses）上的业务：business owner 与 employees 都不合格。
rules.sourceText: The business owner AND employees on this prohibited business would be ineligible. (p36)

rules.title: Exhibit B 禁止行业清单
rules.description: Prohibited Businesses：Adult entertainment；Arms dealers / Gun manufacturers (International)；Bearer shares 或类似 anonymous owner 账户；Bikini Coffee Shops / Lingerie Bars；Cash/Clearing Services（Cash Letter、Bulk cash delivery involving any foreign country、Pouch services）；Crypto / Virtual currency companies；Convicted felons for BSA-related crimes；Correspondent shell banks、unlicensed banks 或 Payable-Through Account (PTA)；Crowdfunding；Defense services (International)；EB-5 New Regional Centers；被 OFAC Sanctions (SDNs) 或 FinCEN 311 Special Measures 指定的实体/个人；Internet café (International)；Internet 或 unlawful gambling companies；Marijuana 及相关业务；Massage parlors and massage parlor owners；Maternity Tourism；Non-bank Financial Institution (NBFI)：MSB (International)（Currency Dealers/Exchangers、Check Cashers、Issuers/Sellers of Traveler's Checks、Money Transmitters）、Payday lenders、Unlicensed MSBs 与 NBFIs 及为其提供金融服务的实体。
rules.sourceText: Prohibited Businesses table (Exhibit B, p36)

rules.title: Massage parlor 硬性拒绝（含网站/Yelp 提及）
rules.description: No massage parlor，无例外，hard stop。即使该业务本身不是按摩业务，但只要网站和/或 Yelp 提到 massage service，贷款即不合格。
rules.sourceText: 2. Employment – No massage parlor. No exception. Hard stop. (p11) / 5. Employment – be aware of "massage businesses" – even though the business is not a massage business, but if the website and/or Yelp mention "massage service", loan is ineligible. (p8)

rules.title: Exhibit C 高风险行业：业主不合格、员工可以
rules.description: Exhibit C（Higher-Risk Prospective Customer）上的业务：business owner NOT ok；employees ok。
rules.sourceText: The business owner on this Higher-Risk list is NOT ok. Employees from this Higher-Risk list will be ok. (p37) / US Citizen owns a legal casino is NOT ok (Casino is on Exhibit C); US Citizen working for a legal casino is ok (p39)

rules.title: Exhibit C 高风险行业清单
rules.description: Higher-Risk Prospective Customer：Arms dealers / defense services (Domestic)；Art dealers or Auctioneers；Boat, RV, vehicle importers/exporters；Charitable organizations (International)；Convicted felons — other than BSA crimes；Correspondent Banks（DCA/FCA、RMA）；Concentration Accounts；CTR Exemptions；De Facto clients；Embassy and Foreign Consulate (EFC)；南加州的 Garment industry import/export companies；Hemp 或 CBD 相关业务；Metals Recycling Companies；NBFI（Casinos and gambling establishments、Dealer in Precious Metals/Stones/Jewels、Investment advisors、commodities traders、securities broker-dealers、lenders or finance companies、investment companies、non-US venture capital companies and private equity firms、PIC (mutual/hedge fund)、MSB (Domestic)、Pawnshops or pawnbrokers）；NGO (International)；Offshore businesses (Foreign and not based in the U.S., China, Hong Kong, or Taiwan)；PATM owners/operators；Politically Exposed Person (PEP)（Domestic or Foreign）；Telecommunications / phone cards / telephone centers；Third-Party Payment Processors (TPPP)（ISO、Merchant Service Provider、Operators of Credit Card Systems、Payroll Services）。
rules.sourceText: Higher-Risk Prospective Customer table (Exhibit C, p37)

rules.title: Offshore business 判定示例
rules.description: Foreign National from Canada is ok；Foreign National from Canada owning a business in Canada is NOT ok（Off short business 在 Exhibit C 上）；Foreign National from China owning a business in China is ok（China 属于清单排除范围）。
rules.sourceText: Foreign National from Canada owning a business in Canada is NOT ok (Off short business is on Exhibit C) / Foreign National from China owning a business in China is ok (China is ok as Off short business is on Exhibit C) (p39) / Offshore businesses (Foreign and not based in the U.S., China, Hong Kong, or Taiwan) (p37)

rules.title: Source of Wealth LOE（未在职或工作史不足 2 年）
rules.description: 当 borrower 目前未就业和/或雇佣史不足 2 年时，需要 Source of Wealth LOE；LOE 需说明 1003 上资产如何积累以及如何负担月供。可接受来源举例：过去工作的储蓄、家庭继承、家庭资金（父母/配偶）、投资收益（股票、房产出售）、离婚所得。
rules.sourceText: 10. Source of Wealth LOE is required when borrower is not currently employed and/or has less than 2 years employment history. (p12) / Need an LOE on how the borrower accumulated the assets disclosed on 1003 and how can they afford the mortgage payments (saving, inheritance, property appreciation, etc…) if borrower is not currently on a job. (p23) / Example for Source of Wealth LOE (p41)

rules.title: UW 会审 fraud report 与 credit report 排查 Exhibit B/C
rules.description: UW 会审阅 fraud report、credit report，确保无 Exhibit B 或 C 相关业务；也会审阅所有存款流水，确保 borrower 不受雇于 Exhibit B 上的业务。
rules.sourceText: 3. UW will review fraud report, credit report to ensure no business related to Exhibit B or C. 4. UW's will review all deposits to assets– to ensure Borrower is NOT employed by business on Exhibit B. (p11)

rules.title: DTI 不适用；Primary/2nd 用 DTA
rules.description: DTI – NA（no income documentation loan），但仍需审阅 employment（见 Exhibit B 与 C）。Primary 与 2nd home 需计算 DTA。
rules.sourceText: DTI – NA – no income documentation loan (but will need to review employment, please see exhibit B and exhibit C). For primary and 2nd home – need DTA calculation (p19)

rules.title: DTA 上限 60%
rules.description: DTA - max 60%。DTA = Debts to Assets ratio = Total debts / Total Assets < 60%。
rules.sourceText: DTA- max 60%  DTA = Debts to Assets ratio = Total debts / Total Assets < 60% (p19)

rules.title: DTA Total debts 定义（第 19 页版本）
rules.description: Total debts = 所有 REO 的 loan balance + 信用报告上的 installment 与 revolving debts + 未结清的 collection、lien 与 charged off balance。
rules.sourceText: Total debts = loan balance on all REOs + installment and revolving debts on CR + outstanding collection & lien & charged off balance. (p19)

rules.title: DTA Total assets 定义（第 19 页版本）
rules.description: Total assets = 所有 REO 的 Zillow value（按 ownership % 折算）+ 扣除 cash to close 后的 liquid 与 non-liquid funds（bank、stocks、retirement）+ 其他资产的 FMV。
rules.sourceText: Total assets = Zillow value on all REOs (subject to ownership %) + liquid & non-liquid funds (bank, stocks, retirement) after cash to close + FMV of other assets (p19)

rules.title: DTA 定义（第 21 页 Purchase 表格版本）
rules.description: Purchase：Total debts = subject property 上新的 loan amount + 1003/信用报告/其他来源披露的所有借款人负有责任的未偿余额（含 collections、tax liens、legally enforceable 的 unpaid charge offs）。Total assets = subject property 市值（按 appraisal report）+ 所有已核实资产（含按 ownership 百分比调整的 tangible assets）− 用于购买 subject property 的资产。
rules.sourceText: On a purchase transaction, total debts and assets are defined as follows: Total debts: New loan amount financed on subject property plus All outstanding balances of obligations as disclosed on 1003, credit report, and/or other sources for which the borrower is obligated (including collections, tax liens, and unpaid charge offs that are legally enforceable). Total assets: Subject property market value (per appraisal report) plus All verified assets (including tangible assets adjusted for ownership percentage) minus Assets used to purchase subject property. (p21)

rules.title: DTA 定义（第 21 页 Refinance 表格版本）
rules.description: Refinance：Total debts = subject property 上新的 loan amount + 所有未偿负债余额（含 collections、tax liens、legally enforceable 的 unpaid charge offs）− subject property 上现有的未偿留置权。Total assets = subject property 市值（按 appraisal report）+ 所有已核实资产（含按 ownership 百分比调整的 tangible assets）。
rules.sourceText: On a refinance transaction ... Total debts: New loan amount financed on subject property plus All outstanding balances of obligations ... minus Current outstanding lien on subject property. Total assets: Subject property market value (per appraisal report) plus All verified assets (including tangible assets adjusted for ownership percentage). (p21)

rules.title: DTA 计算示例（第 20 页）
rules.description: 示例：Purchase price $2m，loan amt $1.2m（60% LTV，$800K down）；Departing home Zillow $1m，loan $700k；Bank $950k；Retirement $70k；Closing costs $15k；Car loan $20k；Credit card $5k。Total assets = 2,000,000 + 1,000,000 + 950,000 + 70,000 + 20,000 − 800,000 − 15,000 = 3,225,000；Total liabilities = 1,200,000 + 700,000 + 20,000 + 5,000 = 1,925,000；DTA = 59.69% - Eligible。

rules.title: DTA 价值基准：purchase price 与 appraisal 取低
rules.description: DTA ratio 基于 purchase price 或 appraisal value —— 取较低者。
rules.sourceText: 14. DTA ratio is based on purchase price or appraisal value – whichever is LOWER (p12)

rules.title: 境外房产若无贷款可不计入 DTA
rules.description: Foreign property does not need to be included if free and clear。
rules.sourceText: Foreign property does not need to be included if free and clear. (p19)

rules.title: 车贷在 DTA 中的抵消处理
rules.description: Auto loan 若车辆价值 > 贷款余额且未被用作 non-liquid assets，则在 DTA 中假定为资产/负债相互抵消。
rules.sourceText: Auto loan is assumed to be offsetting asset/liability for DTA if value >loan balance and not used as non-liquid assets (p19)

rules.title: Lease 支出不计入 DTA
rules.description: Leased expenses do not count towards DTA calculation。
rules.sourceText: Leased expenses do not count towards DTA calculation (p29)

rules.title: Gift funds 计入 DTA，CTC 后不可更改
rules.description: Gift funds 是 DTA 计算的一部分，必须在出 DOC 前准确；CTC 之后不能更改 gift fund 金额。
rules.sourceText: Gifts fund is part of DTA calculation, need to be accurate before DOC. Cannot change gift fund amount once CTC. (p27)

rules.title: Investment 不需要 DTA
rules.description: For investment property – no need for DTA。
rules.sourceText: For investment property – no need for DTA. (p22)

rules.title: Tangible assets（REO 净值）计入 DTA
rules.description: Tangible assets —— 如 borrower 持有的 REO —— 以净值（FMV 减 loan amount）计入 DTA；净值亦可作为 non-liquid reserve。
rules.sourceText: 13) Tangible assets – like REO that borrower owned – net value (FMV less loan amount) can be used for DTA calculation. Net value can be used as non-liquid reserve. (p43)

rules.title: Investment 走 DSCR，可 no ratio
rules.description: Investment 用 DSCR；DSCR 可以是 no ratio。
rules.sourceText: DSCR for investment (DSCR can be no ratio) (p2)

rules.title: DSCR >= 1.2：6 个月 liquid reserve
rules.description: DSCR >= 1.2 —— 6 months liquid reserve（subject PITIA）。
rules.sourceText: DSCR >= 1.2 – 6 months liquid reserve (p22) / 6 months of subject PITIA (liquid reserve) for DSCR ratio > 1.2 (p25)

rules.title: DSCR < 1.2 或 no ratio：12 个月 reserve
rules.description: DSCR < 1.2（或 no ratio）—— 12 个月 reserve（6 个月 liquid，6 个月 non-liquid 可以）。
rules.sourceText: DSCR <1.2 (or no ratio) – 12 months reserve (6 months liquid, 6 months non-liquid ok) (p22)

rules.title: LTV < 45% 时 cash out proceeds 可作 reserve
rules.description: 第 22 页：If LTV < 45%, cash out proceeds can be used as reserve（if DSCR >1, no reserve needed）。第 25 页写法不同（DSCR >= 1%，6 month if DSCR < 1%，3 months non-liquid 可来自 cash out proceeds，borrower 需 3 months liquid reserves）。
rules.sourceText: If LTV < 45%, cash out proceeds can be used as reserve, (if DSCR >1, no reserve needed) (p22) / If LTV is < 45% - no reserve if DSCR >= 1%; 6 month if DSCR is < 1%, 3 months non-liquid reserves can be from cash out proceeds, borrower need to have 3 months liquid reserves. (p25)

rules.title: Investment Loans 选项表（第 25 页）
rules.description: LTV 45.01-50%：Option A - Min 120% DSCR + 6 months PITIA post-closing liquid reserves；Option B - 12 months PITIA post-closing reserves（其中至少 6 个月为 liquid asset，其余可来自 non-liquid assets）。LTV Up to 45%：Option A - Min 100% DSCR，无 reserve 要求；Option B - 6 months PITIA post-closing reserves（其中至少 3 个月 liquid，其余可来自 non-liquid assets 或 subject cash proceeds）。
rules.sourceText: When the property is determined to be an investment property, Loan must meet one of the following options: 45.01- 50% / Up to 45% (Option A- DSCR, Option B- Asset) (p25)

rules.title: 租金收入文件（三选一）
rules.description: 租金收入必须以下列之一证明：(1) 已签署的租约 + reasonability test（Zillow、Rent O Meter 等），取 stated rent 与 reasonability test 的较低者；(2) 独立来源的 Realtor/broker 估算租金；(3) 通过 appraisal 订购的 rent schedule 所得市场租金。
rules.sourceText: Documentation for rental income must be one of the following: 1. Executed rental agreement, and reasonability test (Zillow, Rent O Meter, etc.) to support rental income. Lower of the stated rent or the reasonability test must be used. OR 2. Realtor/broker-estimated rental income from independent source. OR 3. Market rents via rent schedule ordered on appraisal (p22)

rules.title: NY 的 DSCR 要求（NY 不在放款区域内）
rules.description: 第 22 页写 NY require DSCR>=1.2 with min 6 months PITIA post-closing liquid reserves，但第 7 页放款区域不含 NY。需人工确认该条是否为残留文本。
rules.sourceText: NY require DSCR>=1.2 with min 6 months PITIA post-closing liquid reserves (p22)

rules.title: Refi 且 subject 空置：个案审核
rules.description: If refi and subject is vacant – case by case – needs to make sense。
rules.sourceText: If refi and subject is vacant – case by case – needs to make sense (p22)

rules.title: Primary/2nd home 的 reserve 分档（FICO 700）
rules.description: Minimum Credit Score 700 and above → 12 months PITIA（min. 6 months liquid assets，其余可来自 non-liquid assets）。Below 700 including no credit score → 18 months PITIA（min. 12 months liquid assets，其余可来自 non-liquid assets）。
rules.sourceText: 700 and above: 12 months PITIA (min. 6 months liquid assets, remaining may come from non-liquid assets). Below 700 including no credit score: 18 months PITIA (min. 12 months liquid assets, remaining may come from non-liquid assets) (p24)

rules.title: Reserve 按 Qualifying Rate 的 PITIA 计算
rules.description: Reserves calculate based on PITIA of Qualifying Rate。
rules.sourceText: Reserves calculate based on PITIA of Qualifying Rate (p24)

rules.title: Gift funds 不可作为 reserves
rules.description: Gift funds can't be used as reserves（多处重复，无例外表述）。
rules.sourceText: Gift funds can't be used as reserves. (p2, p24, p25) / Gift fund cannot be used for reserve (p26, p27)

rules.title: Gift of equity 不可作为 reserves
rules.description: Gift of equity 可用于 closing cost 与 downpayment，不可用于 reserves。
rules.sourceText: Gift of equity can be used as closing cost and downpayment, not eligible for reserves (p28)

rules.title: Borrowed funds 不可作为 reserves
rules.description: Borrowed funds（其他 REO 的 cash out、HELOC 提款）可用于 DTA 计算，不可作为 reserve。
rules.sourceText: 12) Borrowed funds – Cash out from other REO, pulling money from HELOC. Ok for DTA calculation. Cannot be used as reserve. (p43)

rules.title: 非流动资产的定义
rules.description: Non-liquid asset 包括：美国与境外房地产的净值（net equity）、Auto、boats、gold & silver bullion。REO equity 可作为 reserve 要求中的 non-liquid 部分。
rules.sourceText: Non-liquid asset as reverse: net equity of real estate(US & Foreign)/Auto/boats/gold &Silver bullion (p25) / Equity in REO can be used as reserve (non-liquid portion of the reserve requirement). (p2)

rules.title: 境外银行资金可作为 reserve
rules.description: Funds in foreign bank account can be used as reserve。
rules.sourceText: Funds in foreign bank account can be used as reserve (p24, p25)

rules.title: 同一笔流动资产不可在并行贷款中重复使用
rules.description: Liquid assets being considered for approval on one loan may not be considered on other concurrent loans。
rules.sourceText: Liquid assets being considered for approval on one loan may not be considered on other concurrent loans. (p24, p25)

rules.title: Retirement funds 折算比例
rules.description: Retirement funds：超过 59½ —— 100% 作为 liquid funds；未满 59½ —— 70% 作为 liquid funds，或 100% 作为 non-liquid fund。第 42 页另述：DTA 计算按 100%，若作为 liquid reserve 按 70%；需要 terms of withdraw；无法支取的（如 pension）不可使用；IRA 不需要 terms of withdrawal。
rules.sourceText: Retirement funds – over 59 ½ - 100% as liquid funds; under 59 ½ - 70% as liquid funds or 100% if used as non-liquid fund (p26) / 4) Retirement funds – 100% for DTA calculation – need terms of withdraw. If the borrower cannot access the funds (such as pension) cannot be used. IRA does not need terms of withdrawal. 70% if used as liquid reserve. (p42)

rules.title: Cash out proceeds 作为 reserve 的例外
rules.description: C/O proceed 不可作 reserves，例外：investment DSCR 且 LTV<=45%（第 6 页）/ LTV<45%（第 22、25 页）。三处阈值写法不一致。
rules.sourceText: C/O proceed can't be as reserves except investment DSCR for LTV<=45% (p6) / If LTV < 45%, cash out proceeds can be used as reserve (p22)

rules.title: 有足够 gift funds 时用自有资金做 reserve
rules.description: Use own funds as reserves if enough gift funds（即 gift 用于首付与费用，自有资金留作 reserve）。
rules.sourceText: 6: Asset: Use own funds as reserves if enough gift funds (p6)

rules.title: 个人银行账户：2 个月对账单，不接受 VOD
rules.description: 需要 2 months bank statements；美国银行不接受 VOD；需要 source large deposits。
rules.sourceText: Need 2 months bank statements. VOD is not allowed for US bank. (p26) / 1) Personal bank account – need 2 months – no VOD – need to source large deposits – 100% of pitia (p42)

rules.title: Stock & bonds 100% 计入
rules.description: Stock & bonds – 100%，no haircut，需要 2 个月记录，sourcing 规则适用。DTA 与 reserve 均可。
rules.sourceText: Stock & bonds – 100% (p26) / 2) Stock/Bonds – 100% no haircut – need 2 months – sourcing applies. DTA and reserve ok. (p42)

rules.title: 境外银行账户
rules.description: 境外银行账户需要 2 个月对账单，sourcing 规则适用；若无对账单，需要 VOD —— 需注明开户日期、期初余额、期末余额与平均余额。DTA 与 reserve 均可。
rules.sourceText: 3) Foreign bank account – needs 2 months bank statements – sourcing applies. If no bank statement is available – need VOD – need date account was opened. Beginning balance, ending balance and average balance. DTA and reserve ok. (p42)

rules.title: Business funds 按持股比例使用
rules.description: Business funds 可用于 reserve 与 cash to close，按 ownership % 折算；若持股低于 100%，需要其他股东的 access letter。需要 2 个月对账单与所有权证明。
rules.sourceText: Business funds for reserve and cash to close – ok based on ownership %; if less then 100%, need access letter from other owners (p26) / 8) Business funds – need 2 months statement – need proof of ownership (article of incorporation, CPA letter, etc…), Need access letter if not 100% owned business. Subject to ownership %. DTA and reserve ok. (p43)

rules.title: Business funds 的所有权证明：不接受税表/K1
rules.description: 使用 business funds 需要 CPA letter 或其他法律文件证明持股比例；Business tax return schedule 或 K1 不被接受作为证明。
rules.sourceText: 2. Using business funds – need to get CPA letter or other legal documents to prove ownership %. Business tax return schedule or K1 will not be accepted as proof. (p8)

rules.title: Business funds：持股低于 100% 需全体股东 access letter
rules.description: Using business funds – need to get access letter for ALL owners if borrower owns less than 100%。
rules.sourceText: 3. Using business funds – need to get access letter for ALL owners if borrower owns less than 100%. (p8)

rules.title: Crypto 必须已变现为美元
rules.description: Crypto 不允许，除非已经变现且可以 sourcing；需要文件追踪从 borrower 的 crypto 账户转入个人银行账户的资金。未变现不可使用。
rules.sourceText: Crypto – not allowed unless it has been liquidated and can be sourced. (p26) / 6) Crypto – can only be used if converted into US dollars and need doc to trace $ transfer from borrower's crypto account to personal bank account. DTA and reserve ok. If Cryto is not converted, cannot be used. (p42)

rules.title: Trust funds：可撤销可用，不可撤销不可用
rules.description: Trust funds —— revocable trust 可以，需 2 个月对账单，DTA 与 reserve 均可；irrevocable —— 不允许。
rules.sourceText: 7) Trust funds – if revocable trust – ok – need 2 months statements. DTA and reserve ok. If irrevocable – not allowed. (p42)

rules.title: 人寿保险现金价值可用
rules.description: Cash surrender value of life insurance —— 需 2 个月对账单，DTA 与 reserve 均可。
rules.sourceText: 5) Cash surrender value of life insurance. Needs 2 months statement. DTA and reserve ok. (p42)

rules.title: 出售资产所得可用
rules.description: Proceeds for sales of assets —— 需要出售文件且款项存入借款人银行账户，DTA 与 reserve 均可。
rules.sourceText: 9) Proceeds for sales of assets – ok – if doc for the sales and $ deposited into borrower bank account. DTA and reserve ok. (p43)

rules.title: 无法 sourcing 的大额存款可从余额中扣除
rules.description: 若有无法 sourcing 的 large deposit，可以 backout（即从期末余额中扣除该未 sourcing 部分），DTA 与 reserve 仍可通过。
rules.sourceText: If there is large deposit that cannot be sourced, we can backout the deposit (meaning deduct the unsourced portion from ending balance). DTA and reserve ok. (p42)

rules.title: 只需资产，无需收入
rules.description: 本产品只看资产（assets, assets, assets），不需要收入文件。
rules.sourceText: Just need assets (assets, assets, assets). (p2)

rules.title: Large deposit 阈值 = 6 个月 subject PITIA
rules.description: Large deposit = 6 months PITIA on subject —— 需要 sourcing。
rules.sourceText: Large deposit = 6 months PITIA on subject – need sourcing. (p26) / 8. Large deposits – even though the threshold is 6 months PITIA (p9)

rules.title: （冲突写法）个人账户 large deposit 阈值 100% of PITIA
rules.description: 第 42 页写 personal bank account 的大额存款阈值为「100% of pitia」，与第 9/26 页的 6 months PITIA 不一致。
rules.sourceText: 1) Personal bank account – need 2 months – no VOD – need to source large deposits – 100% of pitia (p42)

rules.title: Pattern deposits 即使低于阈值也需 sourcing
rules.description: 若多笔存款低于 large deposit 阈值但合计超过阈值且形成 pattern，仍需对全部存款 sourcing。若存在为规避 sourcing 而拆分存款的 pattern，也会要求 sourcing。
rules.sourceText: 8. Large deposits – even though the threshold is 6 months PITIA, if there were a pattern and adding up to more than the threshold, we still need to source all those deposits. (p9) / but if there is a pattern of deposit to avoid sourcing, we will source. (p42)

rules.title: 可疑或不符信用画像的存款可能被要求 sourcing
rules.description: 即使金额在指引范围内，若存款看起来可疑和/或不符合借款人的信用画像，仍可能被要求 source。
rules.sourceText: 7. Source of a large deposit – MAY be required – even if the amount is within guidelines – if the deposit looks suspicious &/or is not within the Borrowers credit profile. (p11)

rules.title: Large deposit sourcing 判定示例
rules.description: UW 会在以下情形要求 sourcing：存款（电汇）摘要中出现人名，可能被视为 Gift；存在 pattern（如 6 个月 PITIA 为 $30k，却出现 $10k、$20k 的存款/电汇 pattern）；存款不符合借款人画像（第 1 个月无存款，第 2 个月出现多笔以凑满阈值和/或满足 reserve）。示例：6 个月 PITIA $30k、需 reserve $60K —— 5 月对账单仅少量小额存款、期末 40K；6 月对账单有少量小额存款 + 2 笔 10k、11k 存款/电汇、期末 60k → 需 source 10k 与 11k。不需 sourcing 的示例：5 月 1 笔 $9,797.9 支票存款、期末 40k；6 月 2 笔 $7,983.23 与 $8,760.82 支票存款、期末 60k；或分散在不同银行账户。
rules.sourceText: Example for large deposit sourcing (p40)

rules.title: Gift funds 可用于首付与 closing cost（全 occupancy）
rules.description: Gift funds for cash to close —— primary、2nd home、Investment purchase 均可；允许 100% gift funds（需满足 DTA 与 reserve 要求）。
rules.sourceText: Gift funds for cash to close – ok for primary, 2nd AND Investment purchase. 100% gift funds ok (Need to meet DTA and reserve requirement) (p27)

rules.title: 最多 3 位赠与人，无例外
rules.description: No more than 3 gift funds donor（按人数，不是按赠与次数）—— NO EXCEPTION。
rules.sourceText: No more than 3 gift funds donor (not # of gifts) – NO EXCEPTION (p26) / Gift funds cannot be from more then 3 donors – NO EXCEPTION (p27)

rules.title: 赠与人须为亲属（第 43 页）
rules.description: 第 43 页写 Donor must be a relative。第 27 页与第 26 页未提及此限制。
rules.sourceText: 10)Gift funds – allowed – no more than 3 donors. Donor must be a relative. (p43)

rules.title: Gift funds 不得来自 OFAC/高风险国家
rules.description: Gift funds 不得来自 OFAC/High risk country（Exhibit A）。例：来自 Cambodia 的 gift funds 不可；来自 China 的 gift funds 可以，因为 China 不在 Exhibit A 上。
rules.sourceText: Gift funds from OFAC/High risk country (Exhibit A) is not ok – for example, gift funds from Cambodia is NOT ok. Gift funds from China is OK because China is not on Exhibit A. (p27)

rules.title: Gift funds 存入时点与替代 sourcing 要求
rules.description: 第 27 页：gift funds 需在 CTC 之前存入借款人账户或 escrow，否则需以 1 个月对账单 sourcing 赠与人能力。第 43 页：需在出 doc 前存入 title，否则需要赠与人 2 个月对账单。两处期限不一致。
rules.sourceText: Gift funds need to be deposited to borrower's account or escrow prior to CTC otherwise sourcing donor's ability with 1 month bank statements. (p27) / Need gift funds to be deposited into title before doc, otherwise need 2 months of donor bank statements. (p43)

rules.title: 优先由境内赠与人直接汇入 escrow
rules.description: 始终优先让境内 gift fund 直接汇入 escrow，否则可能需要 sourcing 赠与人的银行对账单。
rules.sourceText: We ALWAYS prefer domestic gift fund send to escrow directly, otherwise may source donor's bank statements. (p27)

rules.title: 赠与人公司账户出资需 100% 持股
rules.description: Gift funds from donor's business account —— 只有赠与人 100% 持股才可以，需要 CPA letter 或其他证明文件；不可作为 reserve。
rules.sourceText: Gift funds from don's business is allowed if donor is 100% owner of business (p27) / 11)Gift funds from donor business account – ok if 100% ownership – need cpa letter, or other doc for proof. Cannot be used as reserve. (p43)

rules.title: 尽早提供 Gift letter，UW 会跑 OFAC
rules.description: Need Gift letter as early as possible。UW 会将赠与人对照 OFAC 名单核查。
rules.sourceText: Need Gift letter as early as possible. Need to run Donor against OFAC list (uw will do). (p27)

rules.title: Gift of Equity 仅限 Purchase
rules.description: Gift of equity 仅适用于 purchase 交易，允许所有 occupancy（Primary、2nd home、Investment property）。Gift of equity 是卖方将自身权益的一部分以 credit 形式转给买方。需要签署的 gift letter 与列明 gift of equity 的 closing statement。可用于 closing cost 与 downpayment，不可用于 reserves。
rules.sourceText: Gift of Equity-Purchase transaction Only. Gift of equity is allowed for all occupancy type: Primary, 2nd home, Investment property. Require signed gift letter and closing statement listing the gift of equity. Gift of equity can be used as closing cost and downpayment, not eligible for reserves (p28)

rules.title: 负债以信用报告为准
rules.description: Liabilities based on credit report。
rules.sourceText: Based on credit report (p29)

rules.title: 非 subject REO 无需地税/保险/HOA
rules.description: 非 subject 的 REO 无需提供 property tax、insurance、HOA 信息（不需要计算 DTI）。
rules.sourceText: 12. For non-subject REO, we do not need property tax, insurance and HOA info. (p12) / No need to provide property tax, insurance and HOA for non-subject (No need to calculate DTI) (p29)

rules.title: 合格房产类型
rules.description: Eligible properties：SFR、2-4 units、Attached 或 detached PUD、Detached 与 attached Condo（warrantable，需 condo cert）、10 acres 或以下的房产。
rules.sourceText: Eligible properties: SFR, 2-4 units / Attached or detached PUD / Detached and attached Condo (warrantable) – need condo cert / Properties with 10 acres or less (p31)

rules.title: 超过 10 acres 不合格
rules.description: 房产面积须为 10 acres 或以下。
rules.sourceText: Properties with 10 acres or less (p31)

rules.title: Unpermitted area 处理
rules.description: Unpermitted area 若无安全问题且不计入估值，可以接受。
rules.sourceText: Unpermitted area may be ok if no safety issue and not included in value (p31)

rules.title: Condo 保险要求
rules.description: Condo 不需要 HO6，但需要 Master insurance。
rules.sourceText: 16. HO6 is NOT required on Condo, but Master insurance required. (p12)

rules.title: RCE 要求（Condo 除外）
rules.description: 即使 HOI 保单已有足够保额，仍需要 RCE（Condo 除外）。
rules.sourceText: 13. RCE –required – even if the HOI policy has sufficient coverage (except Condo) (p12)

rules.title: Appraisal 要求：1 份 appraisal + 1 份 CDA
rules.description: Appraisal —— 1 appraisal with GMCC approved AMC and 1 CDA with Clear Capital。
rules.sourceText: Appraisal – 1 appraisal with GMCC approved AMC and 1 CDA with Clear Capital (p31)

rules.title: 允许 transferred appraisal
rules.description: Allow transferred Appraisal - Updated on 03-05-2025。
rules.sourceText: Allow transferred Appraisal-Updated on 03-05-2025 (p31) / Allow transferred appraisal. (p2)

rules.title: 无需 termite / 烟雾探测器 / 防盗窗改造
rules.description: No need for：Termite report and clearance；Installation of smoke and/or carbon monoxide detectors；Security bars on windows without safety releases。
rules.sourceText: No need for: Termite report and clearance.. / Installation of smoke and/or carbon monoxide detectors. / Security bars on windows without safety releases (p31)

rules.title: 签名一致性要求
rules.description: 所有 LOE 签名、gift letters 的签名，investor 会与 loan doc 签名比对。LOE/affidavit/authorization/loan doc 上的签名必须一致，优先使用带 certificate 的 DocuSign。
rules.sourceText: 1. Signature – all LOE signatures, gift letters – investor will compare signatures to the loan doc signatures. (p8) / 11. Signatures on LOE/affidavit/authorization/loan doc MUST be consistent. We prefer to have DocuSign with certificate. (p12)

rules.title: Foreign National 需在 CTC 前提供 W-8
rules.description: Foreign National – need W-8 form prior to CTC。
rules.sourceText: 15. Foreign National – need W-8 form prior to CTC. (p12)

rules.title: Condo cert
rules.description: Detached 与 attached Condo（warrantable）需要 condo cert。
rules.sourceText: Detached and attached Condo (warrantable) – need condo cert (p31)

rules.title: Early Payoff Form addendum（EPO）
rules.description: MLO 需在 CTC 前让 borrower 签署 Early Payoff Form addendum，以避免 Universe 贷款的 EPO penalty；需要 borrower 承诺前 12 个月不提前还清或提前偿还超过 20%。
rules.sourceText: Need Borrower's commitment through an addendum to NOT pay off or pay down more than 20% in the first 12 months. ... MLO needs the borrower to sign the Early Payoff Form addendum before we can CTC the file for GMCC to avoid EPO penalty on Universe Loans. (p17)

rules.title: EPO / EPD 规则
rules.description: EPO 期限为售出贷款后 12 个月；EPO 是对 GMCC 与 MLO 的罚则，不针对 borrower；贷款无 PPP，borrower 可随时还清；EPO penalty = MLO commission + 任何 lender credit（最低为贷款额的 1%）。
rules.sourceText: EPO duration is for 12 months after we sell the loan. EPO is a penalty against GMCC and MLO, not borrower. There is no PPP on the loan which means borrower can pay off any time. EPO penalty is MLO commission + any lender credit (min 1% of loan amount). (p17)

rules.title: MLO 提交资格要求
rules.description: 提交资格：必须是 48 州内 exclusive/dedicated/committed 的 GMCC producing MLO；须有过往成交经验（否则需管理层批准）；须能设定并管理客户预期；须参加过周二的 weekly LO meeting。LO 必须认识借款人并直接对接；贷款转 servicing 后不得 solicit 借款人；不得在 CTC 前建议借款人移除 loan contingency。
rules.sourceText: GMCC LO requirements — To qualify for submission (p33)

rules.title: No Ratio / No DTI 项目定位
rules.description: No Ratio/No DTI program for GMCC ONLY；本产品为 GMCC 自有产品，没有 investor AE；guideline 问题联系 Production@gmccloan.com 并抄送 mlaw@gmccloan.com。
rules.sourceText: No Ratio/No DTI program for GMCC ONLY (p2) / This is GMCC product so there is NO investor AE. (p38)

rules.title: 必读 Exhibit A、B、C
rules.description: MUST READ EXHIBT A, B, C on this PPT。每笔贷款都需按 Exhibit A（国别）、B（禁止行业）、C（高风险行业）核查。
rules.sourceText: MUST READ EXHIBT A, B, C on this PPT. (p2) / Please check Exhibit A, B, C to ensure employment is eligible. (p23)
